entries.en: The rose mallow beside the shed was bent by a fallen branch.
entries.zh: 棚屋旁那株蜀葵被落下的树枝压弯了。

entries.en: She chose rose pink for the small room's curtains.
entries.zh: 她为小房间的窗帘选择了淡粉红色。

entries.en: A roseate spoonbill moved behind the screen of reeds before we could focus.
entries.zh: 我们还没对好焦，一只玫瑰琵嘴鹭就走到了芦苇后面。

entries.en: The fisherman returned the rough fish to the water before sorting his catch.
entries.zh: 渔夫先把杂鱼放回水里，再整理捕获的鱼。

entries.en: The round kumquat stood in a cracked pot beside the greenhouse door.
entries.zh: 那株圆金柑种在温室门边的一个裂花盆里。

entries.en: The round whitefish slipped beneath the boat and out of sight.
entries.zh: 那条柱白鲑游到船底下，消失在视野中。

entries.en: A rove beetle crawled across the edge of my notebook.
entries.zh: 一只隐翅虫从我的笔记本边缘爬过。

entries.en: Our kite caught in the rowan tree behind the garage.
entries.zh: 我们的风筝挂在了车库后面的花楸树上。

entries.en: The gardener moved the royal osmund into a larger container.
entries.zh: 园丁把那株欧洲紫萁移进了一个更大的容器。

entries.en: A broken chair lay in the shade of the royal palm.
entries.zh: 一把坏椅子放在那棵王棕的树荫下。

entries.meaningZh: 有十二个以上角叉的公鹿〔狩猎用语〕
entries.en: The royal stag entered the clearing as the photographer raised her camera.
entries.zh: 摄影师举起相机时，那只有十二个以上角叉的公鹿走进了林间空地。

entries.en: The ruddy duck swam past the wooden post where we had tied our boat.
entries.zh: 那只棕硬尾鸭游过了我们系船的木桩。

entries.en: The ruddy turnstone paused long enough for one clear photograph.
entries.zh: 那只赤翻石鹬停留了一会儿，让我们拍到了一张清晰的照片。

entries.en: A ruffed grouse crossed the trail in front of our parked bicycles.
entries.zh: 一只披肩榛鸡从我们停放的自行车前穿过了小径。

entries.en: The rupestrine plant filled the gap between the two boulders.
entries.zh: 那株石生植物长满了两块巨石之间的缝隙。

entries.en: She left the rupicolous plant undisturbed when clearing the path.
entries.zh: 她清理小路时，没有扰动那株石生植物。

entries.en: Seeds from the rush family were stored in a separate cabinet.
entries.zh: 灯心草科植物的种子被存放在单独的柜子里。

entries.en: The technician found rust fungus on the damaged leaf.
entries.zh: 技术员在那片受损的叶子上发现了锈菌。

entries.en: The rust mite was barely visible through the small hand lens.
entries.zh: 通过那只小型手持放大镜，几乎看不清那只锈螨。

entries.en: A rusty woodsia grew beside the loose stones at the path's edge.
entries.zh: 一株岩蕨长在小路边松动的石块旁。

entries.en: The laboratory kept the rye ergot culture in a sealed cabinet.
entries.zh: 实验室把黑麦麦角菌培养物保存在密封柜中。

entries.en: The museum displayed a saber-toothed tiger skeleton beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 博物馆在入口旁展出了一具剑齿虎骨架。

entries.en: The sable antelope turned away before the keeper opened the gate.
entries.zh: 饲养员还没开门，那只貂羚就转身走开了。

entries.en: The researcher transferred a sac fungus culture to another dish.
entries.zh: 研究员把子囊菌培养物移到了另一个培养皿里。

entries.en: Visitors rested on the bench beneath the sacred fig.
entries.zh: 游客们在菩提树下的长凳上休息。

entries.en: The sacred ibis stepped behind the low wall beside the viewing platform.
entries.zh: 那只神鹮走到了观景台旁的矮墙后面。

entries.en: The sacred mushroom specimen was photographed beside a measuring scale.
entries.zh: 那份墨西哥裸盖菇标本与一把标尺一起拍了照。

entries.en: A loose saddle feather clung to the side of the wooden crate.
entries.zh: 一根脱落的鞍羽粘在了木箱侧面。

entries.en: The guide led the saddle horse around the broken section of fence.
entries.zh: 向导牵着骑用马绕过了围栏破损的那一段。

entries.en: A safflower seed fell between the floorboards before she could catch it.
entries.zh: 她还没来得及接住，一颗红花籽就掉进了地板缝里。

entries.en: The gardener placed a marker beside the newly planted saffron crocus.
entries.zh: 园丁在新栽的那株番红花旁放了一个标记。

entries.en: A sage grouse appeared briefly beyond the photographer's hide.
entries.zh: 一只艾草榛鸡在摄影师的隐蔽观察棚外短暂出现。

entries.en: The sage hen turned toward the ranger holding the camera.
entries.zh: 那只雌艾草鸡转身朝向拿着相机的护林员。

entries.en: The sago palm stood behind the stone basin in the courtyard.
entries.zh: 那棵西谷椰子立在庭院的石盆后面。

entries.en: The worker weighed the sal soda before preparing the cleaning mixture.
entries.zh: 工人在配制清洁混合物前称量了苏打。

entries.en: The sand badger disappeared behind the keeper's empty bucket.
entries.zh: 那只猪獾消失在饲养员的空桶后面。

entries.en: The sand cat watched the visitor from behind a low rock.
entries.zh: 那只沙猫从一块矮岩石后面注视着游客。

entries.en: The sand cherry had grown across the narrow gap in the fence.
entries.zh: 那株沙樱已长得挡住了围栏上的窄缝。

entries.en: The sand cricket remained still while I adjusted the camera.
entries.zh: 我调整相机时，那只耶路撒冷蟋螽一动不动。

entries.en: The student sketched the sand dollar through the aquarium glass.
entries.zh: 学生隔着水族箱玻璃画下了那只沙钱。

entries.en: The sand eel slipped through the net before we could lift it.
entries.zh: 我们还没来得及提网，那条玉筋属鱼就滑了出去。

entries.en: The sand grouse moved behind a stone as our vehicle approached.
entries.zh: 我们的车驶近时，那只沙鸡走到了石头后面。

entries.en: The operator cleared a blockage in the sand hopper before restarting the conveyor.
entries.zh: 操作员清除了砂漏斗中的堵塞，然后重新启动输送机。

entries.en: A sand lance lay beside the other fish in the shallow observation tray.
entries.zh: 一条玉筋鱼与其他鱼一起躺在浅观察盘里。

entries.en: The sand launce turned sharply when the light swept across the tank.
entries.zh: 灯光扫过水缸时，那条玉筋鱼猛地转了个方向。

entries.en: The sand martin landed on a cable above the parked bus.
entries.zh: 那只灰沙燕落在停着的公交车上方的一根电缆上。

entries.en: The sand shark passed beneath the observation window without slowing down.
entries.zh: 那条沙鲨从观景窗下方游过，没有减速。

entries.en: The sand sole swam out of the diver's camera frame.
entries.zh: 那条沙鲽鱼游出了潜水员相机的取景范围。

entries.en: The collector donated seeds from the sandalwood family to the botanical garden.
entries.zh: 收藏者向植物园捐赠了檀香科植物的种子。

entries.en: She propped up the sandalwood tree after its wooden support snapped.
entries.zh: 那棵檀香的木支架断了后，她把树重新撑了起来。

entries.en: The sapodilla tree shaded the table where we unpacked our lunch.
entries.zh: 我们在那棵人心果树遮着的小桌旁拿出了午餐。

entries.en: The satin walnut overhangs the path to the gardener's shed.
entries.zh: 那棵美国枫香的枝条伸到了通向园丁棚屋的小路上方。

entries.meaningZh: 短腿长身的德国种猎犬〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: The sausage dog curled up beneath the empty pushchair.
entries.zh: 那只短腿长身的德国种猎犬蜷缩在空婴儿推车下面。

entries.en: A sawyer beetle clung to the rough wooden handle of the basket.
entries.zh: 一只褐色墨天牛紧抓着篮子粗糙的木柄。

entries.en: The saxicolous plant survived after the old stone trough cracked.
entries.zh: 旧石槽开裂后，那株石生植物仍然活着。

entries.en: The display cabinet held pressed specimens from the saxifrage family.
entries.zh: 展柜里放着虎耳草科植物的压制标本。

entries.en: She found a scale insect near the base of the leaf.
entries.zh: 她在叶片基部附近发现了一只介壳虫。

entries.en: The student removed a scale leaf with a fine pair of tweezers.
entries.zh: 学生用一把细镊子取下了一片鳞叶。

entries.en: The scale moss was photographed beside a small measuring scale.
entries.zh: 那株叶苔科植物与一把小标尺一起拍了照。

entries.en: The factory stored the scale wax in covered metal containers.
entries.zh: 工厂把脱油蜡存放在有盖的金属容器里。

entries.en: A scallop shell kept the loose papers from blowing off the table.
entries.zh: 一个扇贝壳压着散页纸，免得它们被吹下桌子。

entries.en: The scaly anteater moved behind a log when the keeper approached.
entries.zh: 饲养员走近时，那只穿山甲躲到了圆木后面。

entries.en: The scarlet oak hid the upper window from the road.
entries.zh: 从公路上看，那棵猩红栎挡住了楼上的窗户。

entries.en: The gardener left the scarlet pimpernel untouched beside the stepping stone.
entries.zh: 园丁没有动踏脚石旁那株海绿。

entries.en: A scarlet strawberry had spread beyond the edge of the raised bed.
entries.zh: 一株弗吉尼亚草莓已长出了高架种植床的边缘。

entries.en: The scarlet tanager remained on the branch while the tractor passed below.
entries.zh: 拖拉机从下方驶过时，那只猩红比蓝雀仍停在树枝上。

entries.en: The scentless mayweed grew beside an abandoned flowerpot.
entries.zh: 那株淡甘菊长在一个废弃花盆旁。

entries.en: A scorpion fly landed on my sleeve while I was closing the gate.
entries.zh: 我关门时，一只蝎蛉落在了我的袖子上。

entries.en: The diver's light briefly revealed a scorpion shell beside the stone.
entries.zh: 潜水员的灯光短暂照亮了石头旁的一只蝎贝。

entries.en: The scouring rush filled the shallow container beside the greenhouse door.
entries.zh: 木贼长满了温室门边的浅容器。

entries.en: The workers loaded the scrap iron onto a separate truck.
entries.zh: 工人们把废铁装到了另一辆卡车上。

entries.en: She sorted the scrap metal before taking it to the recycling yard.
entries.zh: 她先把废金属分好类，再送到回收场。

entries.en: I used scratch paper to work out the dimensions of the bookshelf.
entries.zh: 我用便笺计算了书架的尺寸。

entries.en: The screw bean stood just beyond the new fence.
entries.zh: 那棵螺丝豆长在新围栏的外侧。

entries.en: The screw pine blocked the narrow entrance to the garden.
entries.zh: 那株露兜树属植物挡住了花园狭窄的入口。

entries.en: She tore a page from the scribbling block and drew a quick map.
entries.zh: 她从便笺簿上撕下一页，草草画了一张地图。

entries.en: The scrub fowl moved into view beside the keeper's empty basket.
entries.zh: 那只冢雉科鸟走到饲养员的空篮子旁，进入了视野。

entries.en: The photographer waited for the sea anemone to open fully.
entries.zh: 摄影师等着那只海葵完全展开。

entries.en: A sea bird landed on the railing beside the empty deck chair.
entries.zh: 一只海鸟落在空甲板椅旁的栏杆上。

entries.en: The foundry stored sea coal in a covered bin near the molding area.
entries.zh: 铸造厂把煤粉存放在造型区附近的一个有盖料箱里。

entries.en: The sea cow moved slowly past the aquarium's largest window.
entries.zh: 那头海牛缓缓游过了水族馆最大的观景窗。

entries.en: A small sea creature swam out of the camera's light.
entries.zh: 一只小型海洋生物游出了相机灯光照到的范围。

entries.en: The student sketched the sea cucumber without lifting it from the observation tray.
entries.zh: 学生画下了那只海参，没有把它从观察盘里拿出来。

entries.en: The sea eagle turned toward the boat as we passed the marker buoy.
entries.zh: 我们驶过标记浮标时，那只海雕转向了我们的船。

entries.en: The diver photographed the sea fan without touching its branches.
entries.zh: 潜水员拍摄了那株海扇，没有碰它的分枝。

entries.en: The sea feather was barely visible at the edge of the photograph.
entries.zh: 那只海鳃在照片边缘几乎看不清。

entries.en: The sea gull snatched a crumb from the empty picnic table.
entries.zh: 那只海鸥从空野餐桌上叼走了一小块碎屑。

entries.en: The sea hare moved across the bottom of the shallow tank.
entries.zh: 那只海兔从浅水缸底部爬过。

entries.en: The sea horse moved behind a strand of seaweed as the light changed.
entries.zh: 灯光变化时，那只海马游到了一缕海藻后面。

entries.en: The student drew the sea island cotton growing in the demonstration plot.
entries.zh: 学生画下了示范地里生长的海岛棉。

entries.en: The gardener covered the young sea kale with an empty basket.
entries.zh: 园丁用一个空篮子罩住了幼小的海甘蓝。

entries.en: The sea lamprey turned beneath the observation platform and disappeared.
entries.zh: 那条七鳃鳗在观察平台下方转了个方向，然后消失了。

entries.en: The researcher spread the sea lettuce in a shallow observation tray.
entries.zh: 研究员把海白菜摊在了一个浅观察盘中。

entries.en: The diver's camera captured a sea lily beside the rock face.
entries.zh: 潜水员的相机拍到了岩壁旁的一只海百合。

entries.en: The biologist examined the sea mat through a hand lens.
entries.zh: 生物学家用手持放大镜观察了那只藻苔虫。

entries.en: A sea mew settled on the roof of the empty ticket office.
entries.zh: 一只海鸥落在了空售票处的屋顶上。

entries.en: She lifted the sea moss from the tray with a pair of tongs.
entries.zh: 她用一把夹钳把角叉菜从盘中夹了出来。

entries.en: The sea mouse was partly hidden beneath the edge of a stone.
entries.zh: 那只鳞沙蚕有一部分藏在石头边缘下面。

entries.en: The sea pea had spread across the lower corner of the garden bed.
entries.zh: 那株海滨香豌豆已蔓延到了花坛的下角。

entries.en: The sea pen became visible when the diver moved the lamp.
entries.zh: 潜水员移动灯具时，那只海鳃显现了出来。

entries.en: The sea pink survived in the broken pot beside the steps.
entries.zh: 台阶旁破花盆里的海石竹存活了下来。

entries.en: The sea raven swam behind a rock before the photographer could focus.
entries.zh: 摄影师还没对好焦，那条美绒杜父鱼就游到了石头后面。

entries.en: The sea robin moved out of the camera's narrow field of view.
entries.zh: 那条鲂鮄游出了相机狭窄的视野。

entries.en: The keeper watched the sea scorpion through the side of the holding tank.
entries.zh: 饲养员隔着暂养缸的侧壁观察那条长棘杜父鱼。

entries.en: The sea snail withdrew into its shell when the water was disturbed.
entries.zh: 水受到扰动时，那只海螺缩进了壳里。

entries.en: Sea spray soaked the ropes coiled on the deck.
entries.zh: 海浪花打湿了盘在甲板上的绳索。

entries.en: The student photographed the sea squirt without lifting it from the water.
entries.zh: 学生拍下了那只海鞘，没有把它从水里拿出来。

entries.en: A sea star clung to the glass near the bottom of the aquarium.
entries.zh: 一只海星附着在水族箱接近底部的玻璃上。

entries.en: The sea swallow passed above our boat as we lifted the anchor.
entries.zh: 我们起锚时，那只海燕从船的上方飞过。

entries.en: The current carried a strand of sea tangle past the boat.
entries.zh: 水流带着一条海带从船旁流过。

entries.en: The sea wolf glided past the diver and disappeared behind a rock.
entries.zh: 那条狼鱼从潜水员身旁游过，消失在一块石头后面。

entries.en: The child found a bottle tangled in the sea wrack.
entries.zh: 孩子在冲上岸的海草里发现了一个瓶子。

entries.en: A narrow track led through the second growth behind the sawmill.
entries.zh: 一条窄道穿过了锯木厂后面的次生林。

entries.en: The veterinary student examined the cow's second stomach during the dissection.
entries.zh: 兽医专业学生在解剖时检查了牛的网胃。

entries.en: The secretary bird stepped behind the keeper's shed as visitors approached.
entries.zh: 游客们走近时，那只蛇鹫走到了饲养员的棚屋后面。

entries.en: The botanist separated specimens from the sedge family before packing the collection.
entries.zh: 植物学家在装箱前，把莎草科标本从收集物中单独分了出来。

entries.en: The geologist sealed the sedimentary clay sample in a labelled bag.
entries.zh: 地质学家把沉积黏土样本封装在贴有标签的袋子里。

entries.en: She lifted the torn seed coat away with fine tweezers.
entries.zh: 她用细镊子把撕裂的种皮取了下来。

entries.en: The museum placed the seed fern fossil beside a drawing of the plant.
entries.zh: 博物馆把种子蕨化石放在了这种植物的一幅绘图旁。

entries.en: A drop of water hung from the young seed leaf.
entries.zh: 一滴水挂在幼嫩的子叶上。

entries.en: The botanist chose a seed plant for the next classroom demonstration.
entries.zh: 植物学家为下一次课堂演示选了一株种子植物。

entries.en: The student cut through the seed vessel with a fine blade.
entries.zh: 学生用细刀片切开了果皮。

entries.en: The biologist measured the segmentation cavity in the magnified image.
entries.zh: 生物学家在放大图像中测量了分裂腔。

entries.en: A segmented worm moved across the bottom of the observation dish.
entries.zh: 一条环节蠕虫从观察皿底部爬过。

entries.en: The sego lily was bent beneath a small fallen twig.
entries.zh: 那株美莲草被一根落下的小树枝压弯了。

entries.en: A sei whale surfaced beyond the ship's bow and quickly disappeared.
entries.zh: 一头鳁鲸在船头前方浮出水面，很快又消失了。

entries.meaningZh: 半导体材料〔计算机硬件〕
entries.en: The engineer inspected the semiconducting material before attaching the contacts.
entries.zh: 工程师在连接触点之前检查了半导体材料。

entries.en: She placed the sensitive plant on a shelf beyond the cat's reach.
entries.zh: 她把含羞草放在了猫够不着的架子上。

entries.en: A sensory hair on the cat's muzzle caught a drop of water.
entries.zh: 猫口鼻部的一根感觉毛上挂着一滴水。

entries.en: The sergeant fish swam past the diver's light and out of view.
entries.zh: 那条军曹鱼游过潜水员的灯光，消失在视野中。

entries.en: A seventeen-year locust landed on the outside of the kitchen window.
entries.zh: 一只晚秀蝉落在了厨房窗户的外侧。

entries.en: The sewer rat slipped beneath the broken door before the torch came on.
entries.zh: 手电筒还没亮，一只褐家鼠就从破门下面钻了过去。

entries.en: A shaggy cap grew beside the overturned wooden crate.
entries.zh: 一株毛头鬼伞长在翻倒的木箱旁。

entries.en: The laboratory received a sealed sample of shark-liver oil.
entries.zh: 实验室收到了一份密封的鲨肝油样品。

entries.en: The installer replaced the cracked panel with shatterproof glass.
entries.zh: 安装工用安全玻璃换下了开裂的面板。

entries.en: The sheep dog waited by the gate while the farmer checked the fence.
entries.zh: 农民检查围栏时，那只护羊狗在门边等着。

entries.en: The botanist collected a small sample of sheep fescue near the path.
entries.zh: 植物学家在小路附近采集了一小份羊茅样本。

entries.en: A patch of sheep's sorrel remained beside the repaired stone wall.
entries.zh: 修好的石墙旁还留着一片小酸模。

entries.en: The shelf fungus was still attached to the fallen log.
entries.zh: 那株层孔菌仍附着在倒下的圆木上。

entries.en: Our shepherd dog followed the tractor all the way to the barn.
entries.zh: 我们的牧羊犬一路跟着拖拉机走到了谷仓。

entries.en: The gardener noticed shepherd's pouch between the paving stones.
entries.zh: 园丁注意到铺路石缝里长着荠菜。

entries.en: She pulled the shepherd's purse from the pot before planting the rose.
entries.zh: 她在栽玫瑰前，把盆里的荠菜拔掉了。

entries.en: The shire horse stood quietly while the groom repaired its harness.
entries.zh: 马夫修理挽具时，那匹夏尔马安静地站着。

entries.en: He rubbed shoe polish into the leather with an old cloth.
entries.zh: 他用一块旧布把鞋油擦进皮革里。

entries.en: The researcher photographed the shoestring fungus before taking a small sample.
entries.zh: 研究员先拍下了密环菌，再采集少量样本。

entries.en: A shore bird landed on the wall beside the empty harbour office.
entries.zh: 一只岸禽类鸟落在了空港务办公室旁的墙上。

entries.en: The short-horned grasshopper jumped from the rim of the bucket.
entries.zh: 那只蝗从桶沿上跳走了。

entries.en: The short-leaf pine beside the cabin had a broken lower branch.
entries.zh: 小屋旁那棵短叶松的一根下部枝条折断了。

entries.en: The mill kept the short-staple cotton apart from the other deliveries.
entries.zh: 纺织厂把短绒棉与其他到货分开存放。

entries.en: We parked beyond the shortleaf pine at the end of the drive.
entries.zh: 我们把车停在了车道尽头那棵美国短叶松的另一侧。

entries.en: The gardener left the sickle alfalfa intact while clearing the adjoining bed.
entries.zh: 园丁清理旁边的花坛时，没有损坏那株黄花苜蓿。

entries.en: A loose sickle feather clung to the chicken coop's wire door.
entries.zh: 一根脱落的镰羽粘在了鸡舍的铁丝门上。

entries.en: The student traced the sieve tube through several sections of the stem.
entries.zh: 学生沿着茎的几个切片追踪观察了筛管。

entries.en: The technician measured the silicon oxide film on the test chip.
entries.zh: 技术员测量了测试芯片上的氧化硅薄膜。

entries.en: The upholsterer stuffed the cushion with silk cotton.
entries.zh: 家具装饰工用吉贝填充了坐垫。

entries.en: The silkworm moth rested on the edge of the observation box.
entries.zh: 那只蚕蛾停在了观察箱的边缘。

entries.en: The farmer examined the silkworm seed under a magnifying glass.
entries.zh: 农民用放大镜检查了蚕子。

entries.en: The silky oak casts a shadow across the workshop window.
entries.zh: 那棵银桦树的影子映在车间窗户上。

entries.en: The silky terrier dragged its blanket beneath the armchair.
entries.zh: 那只丝毛梗把自己的毯子拖到了扶手椅下面。

entries.en: The waiter rang a silver bell to summon the porter.
entries.zh: 服务员摇响一只银铃，叫来搬运工。

entries.en: The silver berry partly concealed the broken section of fence.
entries.zh: 那株银果胡颓子遮住了围栏破损部分的一角。

entries.en: The silver fir behind the house was reflected in the bedroom window.
entries.zh: 屋后那棵银枞倒映在卧室的窗户上。

entries.en: The silver fox watched the keeper from the far end of the enclosure.
entries.zh: 那只银狐在围栏区的另一端望着饲养员。

entries.en: The fishmonger laid the silver hake on a fresh layer of ice.
entries.zh: 鱼贩把那条银无须鳕放在新铺的一层冰上。

entries.en: A fallen branch from the silver maple blocked the garage door.
entries.zh: 那棵银槭掉落的一根树枝挡住了车库门。

entries.en: The gardener removed the broken stake beside the silver spruce.
entries.zh: 园丁移走了银云杉旁那根断裂的支桩。

entries.en: The silver tree was visible above the wall from the station platform.
entries.zh: 从车站站台能看到高出墙面的那棵银树。

entries.en: The silver vine had wound around the handle of the abandoned rake.
entries.zh: 木天蓼已缠绕在那把闲置耙子的柄上。

entries.en: The workers placed a low barrier around the silver wattle.
entries.zh: 工人们在那棵银荆树周围设置了一道矮护栏。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the silverleaf nightshade beside the old stone marker.
entries.zh: 植物学家拍下了旧石标旁那株银叶茄。

entries.en: The student sliced the simple fruit to expose its seeds.
entries.zh: 学生切开那个单果，露出了里面的种子。

entries.en: She pressed a simple leaf between two sheets of absorbent paper.
entries.zh: 她把一片单叶压在了两张吸水纸之间。

entries.en: The student dissected the simple pistil under the microscope.
entries.zh: 学生在显微镜下解剖了那个单雌蕊。

entries.meaningZh: 扫描式红外检查系统〔技术缩略语 SIRIS〕
entries.en: The technician adjusted SIRIS before inspecting the aircraft's bonded panels.
entries.zh: 技术员在检查飞机的胶接板件前，调整了扫描式红外检查系统。

entries.en: The siris tree hid the small garden shed from the road.
entries.zh: 从公路上看，那棵阔叶合欢遮住了花园里的小棚屋。
